tldr: 台股週一（8/10）大漲702點收44,928點、攻上本波反彈高峰，台積電漲10元至2,380元，記憶體族群強攻。
台積電7月營收4,675.8億元、年增44.7%再創新高，前七月累計逼近2.87兆元，AI 晶片需求續熱。
金融業亮眼：13家金控上半年賺4,408億創同期新高；8月高股息ETF除息潮，00878配息1.01元創掛牌新高。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲702點收44,928 攻反彈新高 台積電、記憶體領軍
items.title_en: Taiex surges 702 points to 44,928, a fresh rebound high as TSMC and memory lead
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週一（8/10）勁揚702.85點、收44,928.76點，成交量8,473億元，盤中一度重返45,000點大關後拉回，改寫本波反彈新高。台積電上漲10元至2,380元，記憶體族群更成盤面主角，南亞科、華邦電受惠 AI 與 HBM 需求回溫亮燈漲停，帶動漲勢由權值龍頭擴散至中小型類股。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index climbed 702.85 points on Monday (Aug 10) to close at 44,928.76 on turnover of NT$847.3bn, reclaiming the 45,000 level intraday before easing back and marking a new high for the current rebound. TSMC rose NT$10 to NT$2,380 while memory names dominated, with Nanya Technology and Winbond locking limit-up on resurgent AI and HBM demand, broadening the rally beyond the foundry leader.

items.title_zh: 「台積電條款」8/10上路 證交所放寬注意股門檻
items.title_en: "TSMC clause" takes effect Aug 10 as TWSE eases attention-stock thresholds
items.summary_zh: 證交所自週一起實施調整後的注意股與處置門檻，市場稱為「台積電條款」，避免單一超高價權值股因股價基期過高而頻頻觸發監視機制、扭曲指數連動的監控標準。放寬後的門檻旨在使交易規則更合乎比例原則，因應台積電權重攀升，降低技術性處置措施干擾市場龍頭正常交易的風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's exchange implemented adjusted "attention stock" disposal criteria from Monday, dubbed the "TSMC clause," to prevent a single ultra-high-priced heavyweight from repeatedly tripping surveillance triggers and distorting index-linked monitoring. The relaxed thresholds aim to keep trading rules proportionate as TSMC's weighting climbs, reducing the risk of technical disposal measures that could otherwise disrupt orderly trading in the market's dominant name.

items.title_zh: 台積電7月營收4,675.8億創新高 前七月逼近2.87兆
items.title_en: TSMC July revenue hits record NT$467.58bn, seven-month sales near NT$2.87tn
items.summary_zh: 台積電公布7月合併營收4,675.8億元，月增5.6%、年增44.7%，續創單月歷史新高；累計今年前七月合併營收達2兆8,720.64億元、年增37.0%。雲端服務商持續擴充 AI 基礎建設，帶動先進製程 GPU 與 AI ASIC 需求強勁，使台積電2026年成長動能明顯優於先前預期，也支撐其全年營收與資本支出上修的基調。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported July consolidated revenue of NT$467.58bn, up 5.6% from June and 44.7% year-on-year, setting a fresh monthly record. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached NT$2.8721tn, up 37.0% year-on-year, underscoring how cloud providers' relentless AI infrastructure buildout continues to drive demand for advanced-node GPUs and AI ASICs and keeps the foundry's 2026 growth trajectory well ahead of earlier expectations.

items.title_zh: 記憶體族群強攻 AI與HBM需求回溫點火
items.title_en: Memory group storms higher as AI and HBM demand revives
items.summary_zh: 記憶體類股領漲週一盤面，南亞科、華邦電雙雙亮燈漲停，反映 AI 伺服器與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求回升，加上傳統 DRAM 供給趨緊。這波強勢使盤面主流由台積電擴散開來，顯示 AI 資本支出循環正拉動更廣泛的台灣半導體供應鏈，從記憶體廠延伸至封裝測試業者，族群輪動更趨全面。
items.summary_en: Memory-chip stocks led Monday's advance, with Nanya Technology and Winbond hitting limit-up as the sector rode a rebound in AI-server and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM) demand alongside tightening conventional DRAM supply. The strength broadened the market's leadership beyond TSMC, signaling that the AI capital-spending cycle is now pulling in a wider slice of Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, from memory makers to packaging and testing houses.

items.title_zh: 13家金控上半年賺4,408億 創歷史同期新高
items.title_en: 13 listed financial holding companies earn record NT$440.8bn in first half
items.summary_zh: 台灣13家上市金控2026年上半年合計稅後盈餘達4,408.75億元，較去年同期大增約101%、幾近倍增，刷新歷史同期最高紀錄。強勁獲利主要受惠台股交投熱絡與資本市場蓬勃，富邦金、國泰金領先群雄；成績凸顯股市走強已全面反映至金控旗下銀行、證券與壽險子公司的獲利表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial holding companies posted combined after-tax profit of NT$440.875bn for the first half of 2026, roughly doubling (+101%) from a year earlier and setting an all-time first-half record. The surge was driven by buoyant stock-market trading and thriving capital markets, with Fubon and Cathay leading; the results highlight how equity-market strength has flowed through to bank, securities and insurance subsidiaries across the sector.

items.title_zh: 六大壽險上半年賺1,746億 年增384%投資收益爆發
items.title_en: Top six life insurers earn NT$174.7bn in H1, up 384% on investment gains
items.summary_zh: 台灣六大壽險上半年合計獲利1,746.68億元、年增384%，受惠股市走熱帶動投資收益大增。富邦人壽賺555.8億元、年增126%，南山人壽308.69億元、年增114%，台灣人壽102.76億元、年增42%。此波反彈為長期受避險成本與利率波動所苦的壽險業帶來明顯轉機，股市資本利得成為左右獲利的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's six largest life insurers reported combined first-half profit of NT$174.668bn, a 384% year-on-year jump, as a hot stock market lifted investment income. Fubon Life earned NT$55.58bn (+126%), Nan Shan Life NT$30.87bn (+114%) and Taiwan Life NT$10.28bn (+42%). The rebound marks a sharp turnaround for an industry that had wrestled with hedging costs and rate volatility, with equity gains now the dominant swing factor in earnings.

items.title_zh: 8月ETF配息季開跑 國泰00878配1.01元創掛牌新高
items.title_en: August ETF dividend season kicks off; Cathay 00878 pays record NT$1.01
items.summary_zh: 國泰永續高股息（00878）本季每受益權單位配發1.01元，較上季0.66元增加約53%，首度突破1元、寫下掛牌以來新高，換算年化殖利率近12.4%，除息日為8月18日。創高配息反映成分股股利收益穩健，也顯示高股息ETF為爭取台灣領息族資金，配息競爭日趨白熱化。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend ETF (00878) declared a quarterly distribution of NT$1.01 per unit, up about 53% from NT$0.66 previously—its first time above NT$1 and an all-time high since listing—implying an annualized yield near 12.4% with an Aug 18 ex-date. The record payout reflects strong underlying dividend income and intensifying competition among high-yield ETFs for Taiwan's income-focused retail investors.

items.title_zh: 8月19檔台股ETF接力除息 部分殖利率逾16%
items.title_en: 19 Taiwan ETFs line up August ex-dividends, some yielding over 16%
items.summary_zh: 8月共有19檔台股ETF陸續除息，涵蓋高股息與半導體主題，多檔預估年化殖利率達兩位數，00881約18%、00929逾16%。理財顧問提醒領息族，選擇時不應只看帳面殖利率，更要留意總報酬、淨值走勢與各基金的填息能力，避免單純追逐最高配息而忽略整體投資成效。
items.summary_en: A total of 19 Taiwan-listed ETFs are staggering ex-dividend dates through August, spanning high-dividend and semiconductor themes, with several offering estimated annualized yields well into double digits—00881 around 18% and 00929 above 16%. Advisers caution income investors to look beyond headline yields to total return, NAV trends and each fund's ability to close the dividend gap, rather than chasing the highest distribution alone.
